title: RabbitMQ: AMQP 1.0 post-body properties bypass user-ID validation and reach consumers (CVE-2026-121714)
description: A vulnerability in RabbitMQ's AMQP 1.0 server_mode parser allows an authenticated publisher with write permission to spoof user-id metadata by placing a forged user-id in a post-body properties section. This bypasses user-ID validation and can cause applications relying on RabbitMQ-validated user-id metadata to accept attacker-controlled publisher attribution. The issue does not affect broker routing or destination authorization and is fixed in RabbitMQ version 4.3.5.
